# Development-only Python deps.
#
# Kept separate from requirements.txt so the runtime install stays small.
# Install both when working on the pipeline:
#     .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt
#
# Run the pipeline unit tests from the REPO ROOT (the modules import each other
# as `pipeline.*`, so the root must be on sys.path):
#     .venv/bin/python -m pytest pipeline/tests -q

pytest>=8.0.0
pytest-cov>=5.0.0      # test-coverage measurement

# Code-standards and security tooling for the Python pipeline (config in pyproject.toml):
#   ruff      - PEP 8 formatting + linting (+ import order, security, docstrings)
#   mypy      - static type checking (lenient to start)
#   bandit    - Python security linter
#   pip-audit - dependency-vulnerability scanning
ruff>=0.6.0
mypy>=1.11.0
bandit[toml]>=1.7.0
pip-audit>=2.7.0
